narratives.body: 조선일보 reports that AC Milan collapsed 0-3 in the Europa League after Maignan received a red card. LiveScore reports that Bournemouth defeated 10-man AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League after goalkeeper Maignan was sent off. TNT Sports quotes 'Absolutely farcical!' regarding Milan's failure to make a substitution after Maignan's red card.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Europa League collapse
